part_A_raw_image_pilot.purpose: Show that a small public raw 3D microscopy volume from independent animals can be acquired, pinned and turned into target-free, unit-preserving local measurements. Descriptive only; no fitted biological accuracy.

route.bucket: s3://janelia-mouselight-imagery (AWS Open Data registry; licence Creative Commons Attribution 4.0)
route.access: anonymous HTTPS GET and list-type=2 listings; no account, no credentials, no contact

specimen_choice.rule: an imaged brain with NO prefix under neurons/Finished_Neurons/ or tracings/tracing_complete/ in the public listing, so it holds no released reconstruction and cannot belong to the 22-sample hypothalamic test cohort

image.volume: 208 x 472 x 544 (z, y, x) uint16, one channel (default.0.tif), octree root level of 7
image.frame: MouseLight sample (imaging) space; transform.txt origin and voxel size in nanometres; Horta corner convention
image.crop: 1200 um cube centred on the centroid of the hypothalamus mesh that MouseLight back-registered into this sample's space; the mesh places the crop and is not a feature

features.intensity_qc: statistics in the source dtype and units actually present (recorded per run); no unit conversion
features.bright_signal_fraction: fraction above Otsu x {0.8, 1.0, 1.25}; the spread is reported as segmentation uncertainty
features.orientation: 3D structure tensor in physical micrometres, eigenvalues l1 <= l2 <= l3. The tube-like direction is the l1 eigenvector, weighted per voxel by the gap (l2 - l1); if sum(l2 - l1) / sum(l3) < 0.1 (planar or isotropic texture, where the smallest eigenvector is arbitrary) the status is NO_TUBE_DIRECTION and the direction is undefined. A flat crop gives NO_SIGNAL and a fully excluded crop NO_VALID_VOXELS. The 0.1 threshold was fixed on synthetic sheets and tubes only.
features.compact_object_scale: scale-normalised PHYSICAL Laplacian of Gaussian (each axis's second derivative divided by its spacing squared); radius r probed at sigma = r*sqrt(2)/3 (the maximiser for a Gaussian blob of radius r = sd*sqrt(3)); only when soma-scale sampling is adequate; never a soma identification
features.support_flags: soma-scale sampling is adequate when the largest voxel edge is <= 3 um; single-neurite resolution is NEVER certified from voxel size alone (optical resolution / PSF unknown)
features.exclusion: any outcome or projection-region voxels can be excluded; they are removed from every statistic and replaced by the valid median before smoothing so they cannot leak
never: calling fluorescent signal axons, neurons or projections

exact_gaps: CCF coordinates of crop voxels need registration/2018-03-26/Transform.2018-03-26.h5 (10,254,288,480 bytes), above budget; the 2018-03-26.nrrd is 6.8 GB and Transformed_2018-03-26.nrrd 266 MB
the fluorophore of channel 0 is not stated in the bucket
root-level voxels (19 x 19 x 62 um) cannot resolve somata or single neurites; higher octree tiles would be needed
Horta voxel corner versus centre convention is not stated (half-voxel uncertainty)
part_A_raw_image_pilot.synthetic_tests: planted tubes (direction recovered within cos > 0.95 under anisotropic spacing), planted Gaussian blobs (radius recovered on a fixed grid), exact intensity statistics, threshold monotonicity, half-up crop sizing, coordinate round trip, exclusion invariance and forbidden-name refusal; these establish numerical behaviour only
part_A_raw_image_pilot.run_v1_note: run raw_image_pilot_mouselight_2018-03-26_v1 used the earlier code (arbitrary direction on near-flat data, voxel-grid LoG, sampling-based neurite flag); its receipts are kept unchanged and superseded by this revision. Its root-level orientation (along the 62 um axis) is treated as a sampling artefact.

part_B_model_compatibility_audit.question: Which frozen SYN4RCH model can be scored on MouseLight independent animals using only permitted inputs?
part_B_model_compatibility_audit.mouselight_permitted_inputs: soma position (CCFv3 from public metadata, converted to the mirrored-left AP/DV/ML micrometre frame) and the raw image; no genes, no Cre/peptide source label for most neurons, no partial axon unless a protocol explicitly reveals one

audit.model: paired-projection gene models (frozen logistic recipe, nonlinear HGBT, PVH pilot)
audit.reason: MouseLight has no gene measurements; scoring them would require inventing gene profiles
MouseLight neurons lack Jiao source labels; the frozen API refuses unseen labels; status was no_better_than_baseline (KNN 1.259 vs engine 1.371 log MSE)

audit.inputs: soma + first 300 um of the observed axon
audit.reason: needs revealed axon geometry, which stays unopened; both runs failed their gates

audit.inputs: donor trees + route graph on Jiao TRAIN
audit.reason: development-only and lost to complete donor copying
soma-only, so technically compatible; superseded and not one of the external-test candidates
soma-only, so technically compatible; it lost to representative-neuron copy on both measures in development (1.112 mm / F1 0.101 vs 0.922 mm / 0.198) and is not one of the external-test candidates

audit.model: E4 local kernel regional (frozen brm_template / axon_engine recipe)
audit.inputs: query soma; missing source tag marginalised with the frozen brm_geometry.state_posterior(None)
audit.reason: external-test candidate in the ROOT-owned docs/mouselight_external_protocol.json; its previous full test gate failed, so it is not a validated winner
second predeclared external-test candidate (soma-kernel medoid template with consensus pruning at 200 um and 25% weighted neighbour support), not selected from MouseLight
requires a measured source label; its no-value fallback equals E2, so it is omitted rather than given a fabricated input
no frozen model uses image features; part A is a data/feature pilot only

part_B_model_compatibility_audit.conclusion: MouseLight can supply only soma position (plus raw images, which no frozen model uses). The external test (ROOT-owned analysis/mouselight_external_test.py and docs/mouselight_external_protocol.json) uses two fixed soma-only geometry candidates, E4 (missing tag marginalised) and E6, against nearest copy, global medoid copy, E1 local uniform and E2 local kernel, with E1/E2/E6 as the aggregation controls. Each candidate must have strictly lower distance and strictly higher F1 than every control; E4 already failed its earlier full test gate. No gene model (frozen logistic recipe, nonlinear HGBT, PVH pilot) may be scored on MouseLight, which has no measured genes; the reconstruction engine T1 and E7 need a measured source label and are not used.

part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.source: ROOT-acquired MouseLight texture images/2017-04-19/ktx/2/7/3/3/7/7/block_8_xy_273377.ktx (SHA-256 08eee2363d455e832da48275dfcd11ddb5128fd1deb4a0e422aef94271930627, 11,058,544 bytes) with source_pilot_receipt.json and source_pilot_quality.json; no new download
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.decoder: strict KTX1 reader: identifier, little-endian marker, uncompressed GL_UNSIGNED_BYTE RG8 (format/internal/base), no array elements, faces 0 or 1, key-value block parsed to its exact length, first mip imageSize = W x H x D x 2 with 4-byte row alignment, no truncation; geometry from xyz_from_texcoord_xform cross-checked against corner_xyzs, distance_units must be micrometers
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.image: first mip 150 x 144 x 224 voxels (z, y, x), two channels, uint8; spacing x 0.663, y 0.653, z 0.999 um; native sample frame, not CCF
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.units: 8-bit intensity-rescaled fluorescence (per-channel gamma 2.0, scale and offset in the metadata); not linear camera counts; channel identities unknown
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.selection: PVH atlas-mesh bounding-box centre chosen by ROOT without any neuron target; the patch is NOT verified to be soma-centred
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.cohort_note: brain 2017-04-19 belongs to the MouseLight hypothalamic cohort; only raw imagery is processed, no trace geometry is opened; this patch is recorded as viewed imagery
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.outputs: features.json (both channels), projections.png (max projections with a 20 um scale bar and key features), STARTED and RUN_COMPLETE
not_claimed: neuron, soma, axon or gene identification
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.run_v1_note: run raw_image_ktx_pvh_20170419_273377_v1 is kept unchanged; it has identical features but its figure used whole-volume percentiles that clipped the max projections; v2 changes only the display contrast and label placement
interpretation_limits: dominant orientation lies along z (the coarsest, axial direction) in both channels: consistent with axial point-spread elongation or sampling anisotropy, not interpretable as biological fibre direction
brightest compact object scored at the smallest probed radius (2 um) near the volume edge: not evidence of a soma
bright curvilinear signal is visible but is not identified as an axon, dendrite or vessel
part_A2_high_resolution_ktx_pilot.run_v2_note: run raw_image_ktx_pvh_20170419_273377_v2 is kept unchanged; it weighted directions by (l3 - l1), which can report an arbitrary direction for planar texture; v3 uses the (l2 - l1) rule
